name: CA-38
label: Safe D

key_factors: District leans Democratic by 8 points after redistricting
Solis has raised over $1 million with outside support and no opposition spending
Republican Casas has no reported fundraising
Prediction markets price a Democratic win near 94%
model.rationale: The fundamentals point clearly to Democrats in this post-redistricting seat, and Solis's large fundraising edge over a Republican with no reported resources reinforces that. Markets price a Democratic win near certain, so the race stays Safe D.
model.watch: Low turnout in a down-ballot open seat could compress the margin, but a Republican upset would require a major unforeseen shift.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; fundamentals point clearly one way (post-redistricting), so it is treated as safe for that party.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
This open Los Angeles-area seat was drawn after redistricting to favor Democrats, with a partisan lean of about eight points toward them. Hilda Solis, a well-known local Democrat, has raised more than $1 million and benefits from outside support, while Republican Pedro Casas has no reported fundraising or outside spending.

With no public polls and no expert ratings, the forecast rests on fundamentals and market pricing, both of which point strongly to Democrats. The expected margin is roughly 19.5 points, consistent with a Safe Democratic rating, though uncertainty is somewhat elevated because the seat is open and polling is absent.
